sentences.text: This petition, through jail, is filed by the petitioner seeking parole leave for 30 days on the ground of filing an appeal through private advocate.

2. It transpires that the petitioner is convicted on 15.12.2025 to imprisonment of 25 years for the offence punishable under Sections 376(3), 376(2)(N), 376(2)(F), 376(2)(J) of the IPC and Sections 4, 5(J) (2), 5(L), 6 of the POCSO Act.
